name: LACUNA SIGNAL NETWORK
description: An independent holographic network founded by a consortium of Tier 2 and Tier 3 producers operating out of the Milwaukee Annex. Lacuna Signal specializes in documentary, investigative long-form, and locally produced drama, explicitly refusing Vantablack distribution agreements. The network sustains itself through direct subscriber fees and a cooperative ownership model that distributes revenue shares to its production partners.
cultural_impact: Proved that a subscriber-funded independent holographic network could achieve commercial viability without corponation backing, inspiring a wave of cooperative media ventures across the lower-middle tiers.
story_hooks: Lacuna Signal's legal defense fund is being quietly drained by a series of frivolous corponation lawsuits designed to force bankruptcy before the HelixCorp injunction appeal concludes.
One of the network's founding partners has been approached by a Vantablack acquisition team — and hasn't told the cooperative yet.
A documentary Lacuna Signal greenlit has attracted an anonymous donor offering full production funding, with no strings attached — which makes the network's editorial board deeply suspicious.
